lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: David fled to the wilderness, first to Gath and then into the caves of Adullam. Men came to him — the dispossessed, the in debt, the discontented — and he became their leader.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Saul's son Jonathan, heir to the throne, knew David from the palace. A friendship grew between them that neither could name.

lines.speaker: jonathan
lines.text: My father's spear is in your hand and his robe is on your back. There is nothing between us but silence.

lines.speaker: david
lines.text: I am a man under the shadow of your father's wrath. Your friendship is the only roof I have.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They met in secret at the stone of the threshing floor, and Jonathan gave David his robe, his armour, and his sword.

lines.speaker: god
lines.text: Jonathan chose David over his father and his throne. The covenant between them outlived the palace.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The two parted in the dark, each carrying the other's life in his keeping. A spear could not cut what they had bound together.

choices.label: Remember this when the throne comes 🤝
choices.note: Jonathan's gift is a promise to be kept long after David wears a crown.

choices.label: Put the memory away for now 🌑
choices.note: The wilderness is no place for sentiment. Survival comes first.
